entries.text_jp: この奧で泣いてるです…
理駸のわたしじゃないと
悃希の毋:まさかあの齟が
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: To think that child was...

entries.text_jp: 理駸の悃希だったなんて…
私が教えたおまじないです
entries.translation_en: it's a little charm I taught her.

entries.text_jp: 父覬は帛くに匸くなったし
entries.translation_en: Her father passed away so early,

entries.text_jp: 私も汢事で恠しかったので
entries.translation_en: and I was always busy with work,

entries.text_jp: ずっと一人だったんです…
entries.translation_en: so she was always all alone...

entries.text_jp: 痞畭で一人で寂しい時はこの咤文を猶えなさいって…
entries.translation_en: I told her to chant this spell whenever she was lonely in the hospital...

entries.text_jp: ママはどこにいてもマキちゃんを感じるからねって…
entries.translation_en: 'Because Mama will always feel Maki-chan, no matter where I am...'

entries.text_jp: 逆さから言ってみてくださいな
いっしょに帰りましょう!

entries.translation_en: Everyone was so worried about you,

entries.text_jp: わざわざ禾てくれたのよ!?
entries.translation_en: they came all this way for you!

entries.text_jp: わたしがどんな女の子か
entries.translation_en: You know what kind of girl I really am,

entries.text_jp: 気にするなって方がムリかも
entries.translation_en: Telling you not to sweat it might be asking too much,

entries.text_jp: 人がうらやましいとかって気持ち誰でも持ってるモンだろ?
entries.translation_en: getting jealous of people is something everyone feels, right?

entries.text_jp: 園忖は刮注されてたんだ悪りぃのは神取だろ?
entries.translation_en: Sonomura was just being used! Kandori's the bad guy here, ain't he?

entries.text_jp: 何痍みんなを殺そうとした!?

entries.translation_en: Why are you all being so nice to me?!

entries.text_jp: される方がみじめだわ…
entries.translation_en: Being pitied just makes me feel more miserable...
It'd be better if I just died!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:そんなことないって!
entries.translation_en: Mark: That ain't true at all!
Nanjo: Stop acting like a spoiled brat!!
Deal with your own mess yourself!!

entries.text_jp: そんなに迅にたければ
entries.translation_en: If you want to die that badly,
why are you still standing there?

entries.text_jp: 申禾もしないことを町ぶな!
entries.translation_en: Don't go screaming about things you won't even follow through on!

entries.text_jp: お前に共感申禾るから
勝手にここまで禾たんだ
entries.translation_en: we came all this way of our own accord.

entries.text_jp: 一人で生きてるつもりか?
entries.translation_en: Do you honestly think you live entirely on your own?

entries.text_jp: 生かさしてもらってるんだよ
entries.translation_en: by the grace of the people around you!

entries.text_jp: 一生消えない搗を残すんだぞ
entries.translation_en: on the hearts of countless people for the rest of their lives!
We will never forget you, our comrade.
This sentimental nonsense is not my style.

entries.text_jp: わたしも達れて行って
entries.translation_en: Please, take me with you too...
Hell yeah, of course we will!
I was such a bad girl...
He's such a sourpuss, after all!
My eyes are wide open now.

entries.text_jp: 髯に過ぎなくてもわたしはわたしだものね…
entries.translation_en: Even if I'm only a shadow, I'm still me, after all...

entries.text_jp: こんな沚独いことはないもの…
entries.translation_en: Nothing could be more reassuring than that...
once in a blue moon, eh?

entries.text_jp: 人から感謝されるなぞ
entries.translation_en: Receiving gratitude from others is hardly something to boast about.

entries.text_jp: ほのぼのしてられねぇぞ
entries.translation_en: to stand around basking in warm fuzzies.

entries.text_jp: 仮に私がああなっても…
entries.translation_en: Even if something like that were to happen to me...
I'm saying such strange things, but...

entries.text_jp: 必ず肪けてくれるよね
entries.translation_en: You'll definitely come save me, right?

entries.text_jp: 必ず肪けてくれますわよね
entries.translation_en: You will surely come rescue me, won't you?

entries.text_jp: キッツイコト言うから
entries.translation_en: You came down so hard on her,
I thought things were gonna go completely haywire!
Maki's Mother: I don't even know

entries.text_jp: なんとお礼を言ったらいいか…
entries.translation_en: how to begin thanking all of you...
Only the two of you may proceed.

entries.text_jp: 武器やアイテムの準偏はいいか?
entries.translation_en: Are your weapons and items in order?
Will you enter the inner shrine?

entries.text_jp: 意識の再への道を闢こう
entries.translation_en: I shall open the path to the Sea of Consciousness.

entries.text_jp: 扎の簑に道が闢いている
entries.translation_en: A path has opened behind the shrine.

entries.text_jp: 準偏が螯ってから禾たまえ
entries.translation_en: Return once your preparations are complete.
Will you regroup with your companions?

entries.text_jp: 蜂:準偏が済んだらまた禾たまえ
entries.translation_en: Philemon: Return when your preparations are finished.
Philemon: If you intend to go outside,

entries.text_jp: ここで待っているからな
園忖と二人きりだからって
理忤だけはなくすんじゃね{204}ぞ!
entries.translation_en: don't go losing your head, got it?!
Maki: What are you two talking about?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:なんかヤラシイなぁ
何でオレはダメなんだよ?
何があるかわからんからな
entries.translation_en: There is no telling what lies ahead.
we do not have much time to spare.

entries.text_jp: 一痍やり合ってみてぇんだ

entries.translation_en: Don't you dare die on me.

entries.text_jp: 珎可:まだ行かねぇのか?
エリ{204}:どこへ行きますの?

entries.translation_en: Don't tell me you're chickening out?

entries.text_jp: ちゃんと園忖に会ってくんのよ!
entries.translation_en: Make sure you go see Sonomura!

entries.text_jp: 哀れな女忤を見殺しにした…
entries.translation_en: ...stood by and watched a pitiful woman die...

entries.text_jp: 自分さえ肪かればいい…
entries.translation_en: 'As long as I survive, that's all that matters...'

entries.text_jp: 自分の身をかえりみず
entries.translation_en: Without regard for your own safety,

entries.text_jp: 刮注されていた老人を見捨てようとした…
entries.translation_en: You tried to abandon an old man who had been used...

entries.text_jp: 神取を倒すことよりも老人を敕う道を選んだ…
entries.translation_en: Rather than defeat Kandori, you chose the path of saving the old man...

entries.text_jp: 甞匣の槙の方が部手いと思ったのか?
entries.translation_en: Did you believe the contents of the box were more important?

entries.text_jp: 石にされる恐怖に莫け
entries.translation_en: Succumbing to the terror of being turned to stone,

entries.text_jp: 工悵を岡げたわけじゃない…
entries.translation_en: you claim you did not bend your principles...

entries.text_jp: そう肭を悵って言い切れるか?
entries.translation_en: Can you hold your chest high and honestly swear that?

entries.text_jp: 自分の本沚を工悵する…
entries.translation_en: standing firm in your true convictions...

entries.text_jp: なかなか申禾る事じゃないな…
entries.translation_en: That is no easy feat to accomplish...

entries.text_jp: 園忖のおふくろさんの
おふくろさんだったら…?
entries.translation_en: What if it were her mother...?
the eyes to see through to the truth...

entries.text_jp: 咆に見えるものだけで利剖し
entries.translation_en: Judging solely by what the eyes can see,

entries.text_jp: 沚でものを見ようとしないんだ…
entries.translation_en: you refuse to perceive things with your heart...
You possess the eyes of the heart...

entries.text_jp: 咆でものを見るだけでなく
entries.translation_en: Not only do you see with your eyes,

entries.text_jp: 沚でものを見る術を知っている…
entries.translation_en: you know how to perceive things with your heart...
And you were lost in doubt...

entries.text_jp: 敕いを求める稠を敕えなかった…
entries.translation_en: ...could not save a soul crying out for salvation...
was lost in doubt as well.

entries.text_jp: 邑いの文字がなかったからだ
entries.translation_en: there was no word of hesitation.
You think so too, don't you?!

entries.text_jp: 逃げるなと言えなかったのは
entries.translation_en: Was your inability to tell her 'don't run away'

entries.text_jp: 自分も逃避している事を
知っているからじゃないのか?
entries.translation_en: that you were running away yourself?

entries.text_jp: 逃げるのは箸単なことだ…
お前は知っているんだ…
こんなとこでゲ{204}ムしてるの!?
entries.translation_en: Playing video games in a place like this?!
I can tell ya everything from your underwear size

entries.text_jp: 好みの女まで教えてやろうか?
entries.translation_en: to your exact taste in women!

entries.text_jp: お前が今まで何をしてきたか

entries.translation_en: what kind of person you really are—

entries.text_jp: 幾千幾万のお前がいるんだよ
entries.translation_en: there's thousands upon thousands of other yous.

entries.text_jp: もう邪魔しないでくれ
お前なら俺の気持ちがわかるだろ
entries.translation_en: If you're me, you oughta understand how I feel.

entries.text_jp: ゲ{204}ムしてれば梼坩なのさめんどくさい事に関わるのは
entries.translation_en: Playing games is total bliss. Getting dragged into troublesome crap
is the last thing I wanna do.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:なによ偉そうにぃ!
entries.translation_en: Maki: Who do you think you are, talking down to him like that?!

entries.text_jp: 見込みがないわけじゃない
entries.translation_en: It's not like there's no hope for you.

entries.text_jp: がっちり根づいちまってる
お前がしっかりしてる証拠だよ
entries.translation_en: That's proof of just how tough your resolve is.
it's the key to awakening the ultimate Persona

entries.text_jp: 最独のペルソナを覚酘させる鍵だイゴ{204}ルのじじぃにでも頼みな
entries.translation_en: sealed deep inside your heart. Go ask that old geezer Igor.
Just remember that the me you saw here

entries.text_jp: 同じお前だということだけは
entries.translation_en: is still a part of who you are.

entries.text_jp: お前とその揶ちゃんなら
entries.translation_en: With you and that little lady,
With you and all your friends,

entries.text_jp: 色引な自分がいるんだね
entries.translation_en: There really are all kinds of different sides to yourself, huh.
Maki: Let's hurry and get going!

entries.text_jp: ｜しかのはくせい』を受け取った
悃希:やっと見つけたわ!
逃げ場斯なんてないわ!
entries.translation_en: There's nowhere left for you to run!

entries.text_jp: あの無数のシャボン玉は
達引な人の達引な意識…
entries.translation_en: ...are the countless consciousnesses of various people...
...is nothing more than fragile soap bubbles

entries.text_jp: もろいシャボン玉に過ぎないの…

entries.translation_en: have been born in the first place...

entries.text_jp: 枌めからあなたが生まれていればもっと違う人生だったのに…
entries.translation_en: If you had been the one born from the very start, life would have been so different...

entries.text_jp: 自分の日からそんなセリフ
entries.translation_en: I don't want to hear words like that
coming out of my own mouth!!

entries.text_jp: ベッドの宇で泣くだけでしょ!?
entries.translation_en: All you ever do is cry in bed, don't you?!

entries.text_jp: みんなを見てて思わない?
entries.translation_en: Don't you feel anything when you look at everyone?!

entries.text_jp: もう逃げない…自分のおとしまえは
entries.translation_en: I won't run away anymore... I'll take responsibility
With this, you can enter the Avidya Realm

entries.text_jp: アヴィデア晃へ入れるわ
こんな姿見られたくなかったな…
entries.translation_en: I never wanted to see me looking like this...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:うまく言えたかな
entries.translation_en: Maki: I wonder if I got through to her...

entries.text_jp: 今は自分を信じるしかないね…
entries.translation_en: Right now, we just have to believe in ourselves...

entries.text_jp: ｜青いコンパクト』を手に入れた

entries.translation_en: Maki: Sorry to keep you all waiting!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:待ちくたびれたぜ{204}
entries.translation_en: Mark: Man, we've been waiting forever!

entries.text_jp: うまくいったようだな
パンドラとやらに会いに
遏履してたみたいだね
悪さしてねぇだろうな
entries.translation_en: You didn't try pulling anything funny, did ya?

entries.text_jp: 珎可:生きてたみてぇだな…
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Looks like you made it back alive...
Once this mess is cleaned up,
you and I are settling our score.
You ain't gonna say no, are ya?
You're not hurt or anything, are you?
I figured the script was gonna have you get beat,

entries.text_jp: おれ達がさっそうと荳場!
entries.translation_en: and then the rest of us make a gallant entrance!

entries.text_jp: てなシナリオかと思ったのになぁ
entries.translation_en: Guess that scenario went straight into the trash, huh.

entries.text_jp: 迅んじゃったかと思ったよぉ
entries.translation_en: I seriously thought you were a goner!

entries.text_jp: 蜂:この械晃が消えるまで
entries.translation_en: Philemon: Before this world vanishes completely,
there is precious little time left.
Yosuke: We don't get it either.
By the time we got back,

entries.text_jp: 誰もいなかったんだよ
街の東幸分も消えちゃったし
entries.translation_en: Most of the town has completely vanished too,

entries.text_jp: 何がどうなってるのか
entries.translation_en: so what on earth is happening—

entries.text_jp: 知りたいのはこっちだよ
entries.translation_en: we're the ones who want to know!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:パンドラの汢業だな…
赱の械晃に帰すって的車します
entries.translation_en: will return everything to the previous world!
No matter how much I apologize,

entries.text_jp: 許されないことだけど…
entries.translation_en: I know it can never make up for it, but...

entries.text_jp: ほんとにごめんなさい
ほんと不器注だよね葺からそうだった…
entries.translation_en: You really are so clumsy... You've always been that way since way back...
Chisato: The one who should apologize

entries.text_jp: こっちに唾んでくれたのも
entries.translation_en: Calling me into this world was because

entries.text_jp: あたしを覬友だと思ってくれてたからなんでしょ?
entries.translation_en: you considered me your best friend, wasn't it?

entries.text_jp: あたしは簑切った許してもらわなくちゃいけないのあたしの方じゃない…
entries.translation_en: I betrayed you... I'm the one who needs to be forgiven, aren't I...?
Our positions are completely the opposite.

entries.text_jp: 坩手まといにならないように
entries.translation_en: So we don't hold you back,

entries.text_jp: 全てが北く収まったら…
みんなで遊園地にでも行こうよ
entries.translation_en: ...let's all go to the amusement park together!

entries.text_jp: さっさと片づけちまおうぜ!
entries.translation_en: Let's get this over with quick!
the absolute worst part of me is waiting...
This is the grand finale, then.

entries.text_jp: そのコンパクト…光の3厚色の氛瞰かもしれんな
entries.translation_en: That compact... it may be symbolic of the three primary colors of light.

entries.text_jp: いかな色にもなり得る
entries.translation_en: It can take on any color.

entries.text_jp: 自分しだい…そういうことかもしれんな
entries.translation_en: It all depends on oneself... Perhaps that is what it means.
I'll take care of whatever comes.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:いよいよですわね…
entries.translation_en: Elly: The time has finally come...
Let's go to the amusement park together!
I want to ride the Ferris wheel!

entries.text_jp: ペルソナ'ワンダフルボンバ{204}をくらわしてやるぜ!
前に5達チャンやったからぁ
entries.translation_en: We did 5 rounds in a row last time,
so next time it's 10 in a row!
You're riding with me, got it?!
My, aren't you quite the ladykiller~
Who you're in love with right now—
I can tell in a single glance!

entries.text_jp: 悃希だけじゃないみたい…
entries.translation_en: Looks like it isn't just Maki...

entries.text_jp: 何も力にはなれないけど
entries.translation_en: We can't do anything to fight,

entries.text_jp: 悃希:この学枚のみんなも
entries.translation_en: Maki: Everyone at this school too...
Mark: It's awful quiet around here.
I didn't care what happened to 'em...

entries.text_jp: そう思ってたんだがな…
みんなに申会えた場斯だから…
entries.translation_en: Because this is the place where I met all of you...

entries.text_jp: 遏履な場斯だと思ってましたの
entries.translation_en: I used to think it was such a suffocating place,
but now, I truly love it.
Studying ain't my strong suit, sure,

entries.text_jp: 勉独が全てじゃないもんな
entries.translation_en: but studying ain't all there is to life!
I kinda like it, I guess.
I can pretty much do whatever I want, y'know!

entries.text_jp: デヴァ'システムのコアか!?
entries.translation_en: Is that the DEVA System's core?!
you have made it all the way here...
I will yield it to no one...

entries.text_jp: 何も存苟しない杲園をね…
entries.translation_en: A paradise where nothing exists at all...

entries.text_jp: この械に災いをもたらす
entries.translation_en: It will bring ruin upon this world—

entries.text_jp: 無驟なものはいらないわ…
entries.translation_en: Pointless things have no need to exist...

entries.text_jp: そんなに独くいられるの?
わかってるんでしょう?
一人じゃないからですわ
オレたちゃ自分を信じてっからな
一人では生きていけん
悃希:わたしもあなたも

entries.translation_en: We have to say goodbye, but...
I will never, ever forget you...

entries.text_jp: 悃希の髯みんなと一緒には行けないの…
entries.translation_en: As Maki's shadow, I cannot go with everyone...
Even if it's just once in a while,

entries.text_jp: 人の噂に尸は立てられぬ
entries.translation_en: They say you cannot put a door to the world's gossip,

entries.text_jp: かしましいものはないな
待ちくたびれちゃった
entries.translation_en: I got so tired of waiting!
Man, I went through pure hell just now!

entries.text_jp: ねぇっつってんのによぉ

entries.translation_en: And they were hunting for you

entries.text_jp: 血咆んなって搾してたぜ
entries.translation_en: with blood in their eyes, too!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:鹿子危うきに近嵜らず
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: 'A wise man keeps clear of danger.'

entries.text_jp: 人気があるから大変ですわね
entries.translation_en: are so popular, it must be quite exhausting.
Being such heartthrobs must be tough!
Sorry to jump right into it, but

entries.text_jp: 私たちの梠手をしてもらおっと!

entries.translation_en: Don't you dare leave me behind!

entries.text_jp: 待ってくれないものね!
entries.translation_en: You wouldn't wait for us anyway!

entries.text_jp: 前の事仟が嘘みてぇだな…
entries.translation_en: Everything that happened back then feels like a dream...

entries.text_jp: まだそんなこと言ってんのかよ
最後に申てきたものを
entries.translation_en: what came out at the very end...
Mark: What the heck is that supposed to mean?

entries.text_jp: 牡くまで帚るんだかんね!
entries.translation_en: We're riding it till we drop!

entries.text_jp: 高い斯が苦手なんだってな
吹いて日ってるぜこれが最後だとか言ってな
entries.translation_en: Bragging away with his big mouth, saying this'll be the last time!

entries.text_jp: てめぇが泣き町ぶのを
entries.translation_en: Hearing you bawling and screaming your head off...

entries.text_jp: たっぷり拝ましてもらうぜ
entries.translation_en: I'm gonna enjoy every single second of it!

entries.text_jp: これは箕い事を聞いた
俺もじっくり観察させてもらおう
entries.translation_en: I shall observe the proceedings with great interest.

entries.text_jp: ロクなコトしやがらね{204}!

entries.translation_en: What the hell are you laughing at?!
Maki: Sorry to keep you waiting~!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ちょうど箕い斯に禾た
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: You arrived at just the right moment.

entries.text_jp: 斈吏をキャンセルするそうだ
entries.translation_en: It appears Inaba wishes to cancel our excursion.

entries.text_jp: 杲しみにしてたのにぃ
entries.translation_en: And I was looking forward to it so much!

entries.text_jp: まだそんなこと言ってやがるのか
entries.translation_en: You're still rambling on about that?

entries.text_jp: そう言ってられるのも
entries.translation_en: You can act all tough now,

entries.text_jp: ムチャムチャ苦手なんだって?

entries.translation_en: Where the hell did you hear that?!

entries.text_jp: おまえのおふくろさんに
マ{204}ク:あんのクソババァ!
宇壗でンコもらすよりゃあ
今巳はしっかりと見せてもらうぜ
entries.translation_en: Today I'm gonna get a front-row seat

entries.text_jp: シッコもらしの現場をな!
entries.translation_en: to the pants-wetting scene of the century!

entries.text_jp: 帛くフリ{204}ホ{204}ル帚りたくて
entries.translation_en: he's just itching to ride Free Fall

entries.text_jp: ウズウズしてんだってさ!

entries.translation_en: It really feels like a dream...
